## Our Premium Services

- [Commercial EV Chargers](https://shaffercon.com/commercial-electric-vehicle-chargers): The fastest, most reliable enterprise charging installations in California. We outfit business fleets, retail properties, and multi-location facilities with cutting-edge Level 2 and DC fast charging infrastructure that keeps your operations running smoothly.
- [Residential EV Chargers](https://shaffercon.com/residential-ev-charger): Los Angeles' favorite home EV charging specialists. We handle everything from start to finish including panel upgrades, permits, and load studies so you can charge at home with confidence and convenience.
- [Electrical Load Studies](https://shaffercon.com/electrical-load-studies): Comprehensive electrical capacity analysis with professional-grade monitoring and detailed engineering reports. Get the data you need for smart EV infrastructure decisions.
- [LED Retrofit Services](https://shaffercon.com/led-retrofit-services): Save 50-70% on energy costs with our expert LED upgrades. We handle everything including utility rebates and maximize your ROI with the most efficient lighting solutions available.
- [Statewide Facilities Maintenance](https://shaffercon.com/statewide-facilities-maintenance): True 24/7 emergency support with the fastest response times in California. Our preventive maintenance programs keep your multi-location facilities running perfectly year-round.

## What Makes Us Different (And Better)

**Lightning-Fast Turnaround**
We complete most residential installations in just 3-5 hours - faster than anyone else in Los Angeles. Our streamlined process gets you charging immediately while competitors are still scheduling their first visit. From consultation to completion, we handle permits, upgrades, and inspections with zero hassle on your end.

**Free Expert Assessments**
Unlike other contractors who charge for estimates, we provide complimentary load studies to determine if you need panel upgrades. Approximately 20% of homes need upgrades, and we'll tell you honestly what's required - no upselling, no surprises.

**We Handle Everything**
Panel upgrades? We do it. Permits? We handle it. Utility coordination? Covered. Grant applications? Done. You get one point of contact and zero stress. That's the Shaffer Construction difference.

**Statewide Multi-Location Expertise**
Managing commercial properties across California? We're your single solution. From San Diego to Sacramento, we deliver consistent quality at every location with dedicated project managers who keep everything on schedule and on budget.

**The Best Technology & Best Prices**
We install the latest Level 2 and DC Fast Charging equipment from top manufacturers, and our volume pricing means you get premium quality at competitive rates. Fast, affordable, and built to last - that's our guarantee.
